answer: Track-record caps, enforced per delta: an identity's endorsement weight equals only the verifiable work it had independently graded this same epoch — nothing carries forward, nothing transfers. A sable-jacketed veteran and a day-old clone hold identical zero weight until each produces fresh, separately-attested output. Delegation cascades collapse to the thinnest link, so a raven flock of rented reputations cannot stack: N shells need N live workstreams, re-earned every close. Headcount multiplies cost alone; influence stays flat, and stale records cap at exactly what they are worth — nothing.
